title: spectralDEMATEL: Spectral Diagnostics for DEMATEL Influence Matrices
description:
An R package that computes the spectral diagnostics of a DEMATEL influence matrix: coupling and the total-effect multiplier, indirect and mode dominance, three readings of hierarchy, the entry and accumulation profiles, the eigenvalue condition number, a permutation surrogate baseline, and the closed-form derivative of the dominant eigenvalue in every off-diagonal entry.

The package computes and returns data. It does not draw, read files, or print, so it can be driven equally from a script, a batch job, or a browser-side application compiled to WebAssembly.

Depends on base R and stats only.
